title: In This Farmhouse the Floor KNOCKS Back
description:
Flashing lights and fast cuts from 0:02 to 2:26.

A scary story. It's made up. I spent one summer helping my uncle on his farm.

Some nights his kitchen floor knocks. Uncle Ray knocks back, same rhythm every time.

The farmhouse, the characters and the sound are all built with code and Blender.
pin: ok so who knocked back at the end?
